data.narrative:
Sorcerer is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Austin Tindle, Maxmillion McLaughlin, and Alessandro Vecchi. The company has raised $3.9M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (Linamar, ticker LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation analysis is constrained by limited direct comparables at Sorcerer's stage and valuation tier. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable; the eight same-sector peers lack sufficient concentration at Seed stage or adjacent stages to support a reliable median benchmark. Consequently, only the Stage-Progression method was employed. Using total capital raised ($3.9M, rounded to $4M) as a proxy for post-Seed valuation, a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied value of $9.75M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M (low) to $11M (high), with a median of $10M. This range reflects the single applicable methodology and carries meaningful uncertainty given the absence of granular peer data at this stage and sector combination. Key sensitivities include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for climate-tech relative to other sectors, and the representativeness of $3.9M raised as a valuation proxy absent disclosed post-Seed terms.
